notes.title: PERMANENT PRICE REDUCTION
notes.content:
Penitence is to receive a permanent price reduction. I have decided to do this for the follow reasons:

 I have heard your feedback - the most common being that players are enjoying the game, but the price tag is far too steep for 20-60 minutes of gameplay. As an avid indie horror gamer myself, I would also have similar complaints for a game of this scale.
 Penitence will not receive any further updates or ongoing support. However, this is not the end of Penitence - stay tuned for more info.

Why isn't Penitence free?

 Penitence is a short horror game created by a single developer. I developed this game back in 2019 to learn Unreal Engine, and decided to share it some time later. I am passionately working to make indie game dev my full time career, and every penny helps make this dream come true.

Thank You
Thank you for your support by purchasing this game, I love seeing the reviews and YouTube playthroughs come in, it means the world to me and allows me to do what I love - make games.
